newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil IBGE sees 77.90 mln tonnes grains/oilseeds.
newsitem.headline: Brazil IBGE sees 77.90 mln tonnes grains/oilseeds.

text.p: Brazil's 1997 production of grains and oilseeds could reach 77.90 million tonnes, 6.74 percent higher than the 72.98 million tonnes produced in 1996, National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said in a statement.
At the end of April, IBGE forecast this year's crop would reach 78.19 million tonnes.
Both estimates, however, are based on some simulations, principally for winter crops such as wheat and for second and third crops of some products, it added.
Soybean production should reach 25.71 million tonnes, a rise of 10.77 percent on last year.
In April, IBGE envisaged a soybean crop of 26.14 million tonnes.
Output from the first corn harvest should total 30.05 million tonnes against a previous forecast of 30.57 million tonnes, IBGE said. ((-Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151))
